literal_meaning: সাতজন ভাবির বাড়ি (the house of seven daughters-in-law)
figurative_meaning_bn: কলহপূর্ণ সংসা; হিংসা, দ্বেষ, কলহের স্থান
figurative_meaning_en: A quarrel-filled household; a place rife with envy, hatred, and discord
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পরিবারটি সাত সতীনের ঘরের মতো, সর্বদা বিবাদে জর্জরিত।
সাত সতীনের ঘরে শান্তি নেই, সবাই পরস্পরের সঙ্গে ঝগড়া করে।
example_sentences_in_english: This family is like the house of seven daughters-in-law, always embroiled in conflicts.
There's no peace in a house of seven daughters-in-law; everyone fights with each other.
history: This idiom stems from traditional Bengali joint family systems where multiple daughters-in-law often led to rivalries and household tensions, as reflected in the proverb 'সাত সতীনের ঘর খোদায় রক্ষা কর' (May God protect the house of seven daughters-in-law).
note: The idiom highlights the chaos in extended families, common in rural Bengali culture.
